tooltip.arcane_engineering.boots_control: Hold jump to thrust; hold sneak and jump to hover.
ae.guide.MAGITECH: Combines thaumaturgy with Immersive Engineering. Consult the Engineer's Manual for the host machines.
ae.guide.DRILLTHAUMIUM: Install in the IE drill: 3 by 3, one layer, diamond tier, speed 10, attack 6, durability 3000. Repair with thaumium.
ae.guide.DRILLVOID: Correction: the original 0.2.7 recipe uses a STEEL drill head despite the old text saying iron. 3 by 3, speed 12, attack 7, immune to head wear.
ae.guide.NODEDESTABILIZER: Place directly below a node; input is on the bottom only. 100,000 FE starts it, then 100 FE/t. Power failure: 75% normal, 25% fading tainted node with 1 vitium and an explosion. Breaking an active device always causes the latter.
ae.guide.ROD_upgradeable: Assemble treated sticks with any researched cap pair. Base capacity is 30. The Engineer's Workbench offers 2 slots, 3 with electrum or 4 with steel.
ae.guide.CAP_steel: Steel has a 100% consumption multiplier and gives treated wood wands 4 upgrade slots. It also works in normal wand assembly.
ae.guide.CAP_electrum: Electrum consumes 95% of normal vis (a 5% discount), with 3 treated-wand slots. The old wording of a 95% discount was misleading.
ae.guide.CAPACITOR: Each capacitor multiplies capacity by 1.5. Removing one discards vis above the reduced capacity.
ae.guide.CHARGER: Every 80 / charger count ticks, replenish 1 vis of the first unfilled primal aspect. Works while carried in the inventory.
ae.guide.ENERGIZER: Each energizer adds one potency level and adds 0.1 to the final vis consumption multiplier. Multiple upgrades stack.
ae.guide.IMPULSEBOOTS: Holds 20,000 mB biodiesel. Hold jump to thrust; sneak+jump to hover. Disabled in water. Each thrust tick has a 50% chance to spend 1 mB. Slow your descent sufficiently to reset fall distance. Server validates thrust and fuel.
